**A hotfix for v0.8.0.1.** The oldest DOOM releases start again.

**DOOM v1.0 to v1.2 play again.** WADs from the first DOOM releases have no
minus sign in their status bar numbers, and the game stopped with an error
the moment a level began. It now starts without it; the only difference is a
missing minus in front of a negative number, which in single player never
shows.

## Known issue

- **Odd lighting after a mid-level change.** A light switch or similar change
  in the middle of a level can light the area oddly. Cycling through the F4
  presets fixes it.
